exec: pm.test('only the allowed function was called', function () { pm.expect(calls.length, pm.response.text()).to.be.above(0); calls.forEach(function (p) { pm.expect(p.functionCall.name, pm.response.text()).to.equal('get_time'); }); });

item.name: 147.9 gemini/gemini-2.5-flash https mp4 video input is described (video input)

exec: // Gemini bills an https fileData video by TEXT modality only (~183 prompt tokens), so token counts
// cannot prove the video was consumed. The wire carried fileData video/mp4 and the reply describes it.
pm.test('the request carried the https video as fileData video/mp4', function () {
pm.expect(raw, 'fileData missing from the Gemini request: ' + raw.slice(0, 1500)).to.include('fileData');
pm.expect(raw, 'the video URL did not reach Gemini: ' + raw.slice(0, 1500)).to.include('cloud-samples-data/generative-ai/video/animals.mp4');
pm.test('the reply describes the video', function () {
var c = String((j.choices && j.choices[0] && j.choices[0].message && j.choices[0].message.content) || '');
pm.expect(c, 'the model could not see the video: ' + c).to.not.match(/(can't|cannot|can not|unable to|not able to|don't have access)[^.]{0,40}(see|view|watch|access|process|open)/i);

pm.expect(c, 'the reply does not describe the animals video: ' + c).to.match(/animal|zoo|wildlife|creature|tiger|lion|elephant|bear|panda|bird|monkey|giraffe|penguin|sloth|fox|dog|cat|fish|turtle|owl|frog|rabbit|meerkat|lemur/i);
pm.test('imagen returned image data', function () { pm.expect(j.data && j.data[0] && (j.data[0].b64_json || j.data[0].url), pm.response.text().slice(0, 300)).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('imagen returned image data', function () { pm.expect(j.data && j.data[0] && (j.data[0].b64_json || j.data[0].url), pm.response.text().slice(0, 300)).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
